'''Milo Phipps''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who worked for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Prior to the [[Great Galactic War]], Milo had been a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] and one-time [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. During the Cold War he conducted operations for the SIS on Ord Mantell. Believing that the former criminal [[Veem Set]] had important information about the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]], he enlisted the help of a spacer to break out the captured Set from the [[Separatist stronghold]].
